Both: original RoomJump/intro skip/menu/Warp entry and Start4500/Cross4800 exits. MOVE adds4100v:lright:60; IDLE does not. Full field script and exact selected originals recorded in comparison scenarios.
retained_rejected_hypotheses: A manual signed-immediate error read the wrong fixed address in native16. Those reads were never game writes or valid player proof. Corrected from original instruction words.
Original stored names identify the active-work pointer as CAMERA work. Earlier camera position restoration was not actor teleport/cancel evidence. The actual player vector is used here.

A native constructor call can yield; its immediate C++ return did not prove guest constructor completion. New copied-unit read-only hooks observe actual logical tails, with unchanged original instruction comments/order.
Cross and Start both leave Warp to its parent; another Cross closes that menu. Restoring camera work does not undo the relocated player.

limits: Private prototype native research, not a checked prototype installer, retail backend, complete port or PS2 fidelity certificate. Generated game source and raw maps stay private.
Virtual PS2 input only; owner stopped desktop control. Actual F1/F2-key acceptance after the experimental edge change remains unverified. Diagnostic F2 handler/chord is not a Windows keypress.
Both cases enter Warp and can slightly alter placement. The control is retained; exiting restores normal camera/input mode, not the old actor position. No undo feature is claimed.
Different viewpoints/actor poses are expected; no matched-camera fidelity or image-parity claim. Original PNGs unchanged; no crop, resize or normalization.

Earlier free-warp output includes a detached cloak-like artifact. It is retained, not declared a clean debug renderer. Broader room/invalid-state coverage, no-death survival/restored death, input/audio/save/campaign and performance gates remain open.
Strict VU1 comparison previously fails; the narrower observable result is not strict state equivalence. These runs select experimental AOT without a verifier, not an accuracy/performance promotion.
